verdict.rationale: GitCafe has no built-in natural-language interface, but it runs an official MCP server that lets AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT read repositories and, with approval, work on issues and pull requests. It also offers WebMCP tools to in-browser agents and agent skills for coding assistants, so natural-language operation works only through an external AI client. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface, documentation of which write operations the MCP tools cover beyond issues/PRs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works end to end.
